needed.evidence: A continuous, purpose-built sidewalk is visible along the left side of the road, but it is partially obstructed by parked vehicles.
needed.suggestion: Widen the left-side footway to a minimum of 1.5m and install bollards to prevent vehicles from parking on it.

needed.evidence: A continuous, purpose-built sidewalk is visible along the right side of the road, but it is partially obstructed by parked vehicles.
needed.suggestion: Widen the right-side footway to a minimum of 1.5m and install bollards to prevent vehicles from parking on it.

needed.evidence: Parked vehicles are occupying a significant portion of the left-side footway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway.
needed.suggestion: Create designated off-street parking bays further from the footway to clear the pedestrian path.

needed.evidence: Parked vehicles are occupying a significant portion of the right-side footway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway.

needed.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to the mixed-use nature of the street (shops and homes), but no marked or signalised crossing is present.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with dropped kerbs at the junction with the side street on the right.

needed.evidence: The road is in an urban area but has no street lighting, which is a safety hazard, especially in poor weather conditions.
needed.suggestion: Install a series of LED streetlights along both sides of the road to improve visibility for all road users.
